name: Zhangzangbo (Cirenmaco) partial outburst
trigger_mechanism: Moraine-dam piping (partial outburst)
damage_summary: Little damage reported; partial outburst of the lake that burst fully in 1981
warning_notes: Single secondary-source statement (read via search snippet, not full text); date month unknown

name: Tiptola (Olangchun Gola) GLOF
trigger_mechanism: Ice avalanche into lake
damage_summary: 3 livestock lost, ~50 residences damaged, cropland destroyed
warning_notes: Reconstructed from oral history by Byers et al. 2020 in HMAGLOFDB

name: Nare Drangka GLOF
trigger_mechanism: Unknown
damage_summary: Casualties reported 2-3 (Agrawala et al. 2003 cited by ICIMOD)
warning_notes: Table 3.3 of ICIMOD 2020 does not list it; text mentions 1977 Dudh Koshi GLOF

name: Nagma Pokhari GLOF
trigger_mechanism: Unknown
damage_summary: Destroyed villages up to 71 km downstream

name: Zhangzangbo (Cirenmaco) GLOF
trigger_mechanism: Ice avalanche into moraine-dammed lake
damage_summary: Friendship Bridge and three bridges, Arniko/Nepal-China highway sections, Sun Koshi hydropower diversion weir; ~US$3M damage in Nepal (ICIMOD); 6.3 Mm3 released
warning_notes: Deaths >200 from Sattar et al. 2022 only; ICIMOD gives US$3M damage, no toll; treat as uncertain

name: Dig Tsho GLOF
trigger_mechanism: Ice avalanche into moraine-dammed lake
damage_summary: Namche Small Hydro destroyed, bridges, ~US$1.5M loss; ~60 km impact
warning_notes: Death toll 5 per HMAGLOFDB; ICIMOD says 'a few casualties'

name: Chubung GLOF
trigger_mechanism: Unknown
damage_summary: Damage in Nepal listed by ICIMOD Table 3.3

name: Kulekhani / central Nepal extreme-rainfall debris flows and floods
trigger_mechanism: Torrential rain 19-21 Jul 1993, 540 mm/24 h at Kulekhani (thesis claim); >700 mm total (Kobayashi)
damage_summary: Described as worst disaster in Nepal in 20th century; 1,336 deaths is a commonly cited figure but NOT verified; one source says >1,900 dead and missing
warning_notes: Death figure unresolved; Kulekhani reservoir and watershed heavily affected

name: Sabai Tsho (Tam Pokhari) GLOF
trigger_mechanism: Ice avalanche
damage_summary: Damage in Nepal listed by ICIMOD Table 3.3

name: Koshi embankment breach
trigger_mechanism: Embankment breach at Kusaha during high flow
damage_summary: ~50,000 displaced in Nepal, seven villages swept away; >3M affected in Bihar
warning_lead_time: poor: warning hindered by cross-border communication
warning_notes: Not a flash flood; included as lowland analog

name: Seti River flash flood (Pokhara)
trigger_mechanism: Rockfalls dammed Seti gorge; Annapurna IV rock-ice avalanche burst the dam; not a GLOF
damage_summary: Debris along Seti, floodplain settlements; 20 km in ~28 min to Kharapani
warning_lead_time: none; no instrumentation; Kargel et al. argue floodplain relocation beats warning
warning_notes: Deaths+missing 72 (Kargel et al. 2014 abstract); initial reports 14 then 71

name: Jure (Sunkoshi) landslide and dam
trigger_mechanism: Monsoon-rain landslide ~5.5 Mm3 blocked Sun Koshi, lake ~8 Mm3 formed
damage_summary: Jure village buried; lake submerged houses and hydropower substation; dam blasted open
warning_lead_time: lake filled in ~12 h; downstream evacuation of Sun Koshi corridor; controlled blasting

name: Mid- and far-western Nepal floods (Karnali, Mahakali basins)
trigger_mechanism: Intense monsoon rain 14-15 Aug 2014
damage_summary: Colorado: ~14,500 homes destroyed, ~80,000 displaced; ISET: 222 killed, 120,000 affected
warning_notes: IFRC 17 Aug count of 53 was early/partial

name: Langtang earthquake avalanche
trigger_mechanism: Gorkha earthquake, winter-snow-amplified avalanche from Langtang Lirung area
damage_summary: Langtang village destroyed; deposit ~6.8 Mm3
warning_notes: Fujita et al. 2017: >350 dead; other tallies 170+ villagers

name: Gongbatongsha GLOF (Bhote Koshi)
trigger_mechanism: Debris flow into Gongbatongsha lake, dam breach, 9,000 m2 lake
damage_summary: Bhote Koshi hydropower headworks destroyed; 20+ houses swept; Araniko highway; loss >US$70M (Sattar); peak 4,123 m3/s at confluence
warning_lead_time: none: Zhangzangbo EWS destroyed in 2015 earthquake; night event
warning_notes: Night of 5 Jul; ICIMOD/UNDRR: no deaths owing to rapid evacuation; DHM later traced to GLOF via Google Earth

name: Langmale (Upper Barun) GLOF
trigger_mechanism: Rockfall into lake
damage_summary: 10 families displaced downstream

name: August 2017 Terai floods
trigger_mechanism: Heavy monsoon rain 11-14 Aug 2017
river: Koshi, Kamala, Bagmati, Rapti, Narayani, others
damage_summary: ~6M people affected (govt); 47,350 displaced in IFRC count
warning_notes: Early counts: ACAPS 43 dead, IFRC 64 dead

name: Melamchi flood
trigger_mechanism: Heavy rain; landslide dam in Melamchi River burst at night (glacial lake origin suspected by some)
damage_summary: Melamchi drinking water headworks buried; >Rs 1 bn; ~260 households lost
warning_lead_time: local authorities noticed damming and warned; lead time not documented
warning_notes: Counts differ (Home Minister: 5 dead + 20 missing; Reuters: 11 dead)

name: Birendra Tal (Manaslu) glacier avalanche flood
trigger_mechanism: Manaslu glacier ice avalanche into Birendra Tal (not a GLOF)
damage_summary: One bridge destroyed (GLOFDB)

name: Thame cascading GLOF
trigger_mechanism: Cascading failure of two small Ngole lakes; trigger unresolved (hydrological tipping point vs avalanche)
damage_summary: 135 displaced, ~20-25 houses, school, clinic, power house; USD 6.18M
warning_lead_time: ~20-25 min travel time; roar and upstream info; authorities alerted after event
warning_notes: Neither lake classed dangerous; DHM warning not documented

name: Kathmandu valley floods (27-29 Sept 2024)
trigger_mechanism: Low-pressure system; 240-322 mm in 24 h, heaviest since 1970
districts: Kathmandu, Lalitpur, Bhaktapur, Dhading, Kavre, Makwanpur, Dolakha
damage_summary: 1,200 houses, 25 bridges, 37 highways, 11 hydropower stations; ~35 buried in buses on Prithvi highway
warning_lead_time: govt warnings and night-travel ban; DHM lead time not documented
warning_notes: 224 per govt late Sept; 193 on 30 Sept (AP)

name: Rasuwagadhi GLOF (Purepu Glacier)
trigger_mechanism: Supraglacial lake drainage (638,000 to 435,000 m2)
damage_summary: Friendship Bridge, dry port, Syabrubesi-Rasuwagadhi road, 3+ hydropower plants
warning_lead_time: none; hit 03:15 NPT; RHA: early warning not in place

name: Langtang Lirung ice-rock avalanche, Lhende Khola-Bhote Koshi-Trishuli debris flow
trigger_mechanism: Bedrock failure under glacier; 132 Mm3 (ICIMOD); up to 40 cm InSAR deformation 7 Jul-24 Aug
river: Lhende Khola -> Bhote Koshi -> Trishuli -> Narayani
districts: Rasuwa, Nuwakot, Dhading, Gorkha, Chitwan, Tanahun, Nawalparasi; Gyirong (TAR)
damage_summary: 14 hydropower projects (~748 MW), 40+ km road, 7,570 houses; NPR 277.79 bn (Wikipedia)
warning_lead_time: 0 min upstream; SMS 09:15-09:16 (38 min after collapse) to 679,295; ~2 h to Malekhu
warning_notes: Upstream gauges destroyed before thresholds; first alert by phone at ~09:00

name: Budhi Gandaki (Ungdilung Khola) landslide dam flood
trigger_mechanism: Landslide at 5,500-6,000 m; dam breach ~06:00 after seismic signal ~04:22
damage_summary: Hydropower camp at Salleri destroyed, Jagat buildings, bridges
warning_lead_time: seismic detection and SMS warnings reported ('successful dissemination')
